<?php
trait T184Shared { public function make() { return new class {}; } }
class A184Shared { use T184Shared { make as alias; } } class B184Shared { use T184Shared; }
$a = (new A184Shared)->make(); $b = (new B184Shared)->make(); $alias = (new A184Shared)->alias(); $after = new class {};
echo ($a::class === $b::class), ';', ($a::class === $alias::class), ';', ($a !== $b), ';', $a::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
trait T184Scope { public function make() { return new class(parent::VALUE, self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $parent, public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } }
class Base184Scope { public const VALUE = 10; } class A184Scope extends Base184Scope { use T184Scope; public const VALUE = 11; } class C184Scope extends A184Scope { public const VALUE = 12; }
$child = (new C184Scope)->make(); echo $child->parent, ';', $child->self, ';', $child->called, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
trait T184Capture { public function capture() { return fn() => new class(self::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $value, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; } }
class A184Capture { use T184Capture; public const VALUE = 1; } class B184Capture { use T184Capture; public const VALUE = 2; }
$ao = new A184Capture; $bo = new B184Capture; $a = $ao->capture(); $b = $bo->capture(); unset($ao, $bo); $x = $a(); $y = $b();
echo $x->value, ':', $x->owner, ':', $x->method, ';', $y->value, ':', $y->owner, ':', $y->method, ';', ($x::class === $y::class), ';', $x::class, ';';

<?php
trait T184Ctor { public function __construct() { $child = new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; throw new Exception('stop'); } }
class Owner184Ctor { use T184Ctor; public function __destruct() { echo 'BAD;'; } }
try { new Owner184Ctor; } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }

<?php
trait T184Static { public static function __construct() { $child = new class { final private function hidden() {} }; } }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait T184Invalid { public function make() { return new class { public function bad(int $value = 'wrong') {} }; } }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait T184Closure { public function capture() { return function() { return new class(self::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $value, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; }; } }
class A184Closure { use T184Closure; public const VALUE = 23; }
$owner = new A184Closure; $f = $owner->capture(); unset($owner); $child = $f(); echo $child->value, ';', $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
trait T184Constant { public function make() { return new class { final private function hidden() {} }; } public const int BAD = 'wrong'; }
echo 'BAD;';
